verdict.rationale: Core platform operations are API-accessible: the Search API lets you "search, configure, and manage your indices and records". The CLI and agent skills manage indices, settings, rules and synonyms, official clients exist in many languages, and an MCP server covers search, analytics and recommendations. However, no documentation claims UI/API parity. Several features are described as dashboard-driven, such as connector schedules and transformations configured "in the Algolia dashboard without deploying code", the Merchandising Studio's visual curation tools, and analytics exports via a dashboard Download button. No OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, documented API coverage for Merchandising Studio, connectors/transformations, A/B testing, Agent Studio and analytics export, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
